description: Grands projets de centrales photovoltaïques dans le Rhône is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction Départementale des Territoires du Rhône. Large photovoltaic power projects in the Rhone. Coverage: Direction Départementale des Territoires du Rhône. The portal shows the English title as "Large photovoltaic power projects in the Rhone" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direction Départementale des Territoires du Rhône. Its keywords include photovoltaique. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ODS. The listing shows 2021-05-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
